{{Top}}
'''Kevdan Aerosystems''' was a company that manufactured [[Hydro-glycolic fuel cell/Legends|hydro-glycolic fuel cells]] for [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]].

==Behind the scenes==
Kevdan is named for [[Kevin Vincent]], an Artoo operator at Walt Disney World, and [[Daniel Deutsch]], who provides Artoos and other droids to Disney theme parks.
